q1_issues.issue: (LocatedIn sk_life_1 sk_slum_1) applies the entity-position head to an abstract noun, where the instruction set defines LocatedIn for where a THING is (a village in a county, a jetty in an estuary).

q2_gaps: Content / 'about'-of-phrase on a nominalization ('a depiction of life', 'a photo of Mary'): the genitive section explicitly excludes it from Possession/PartOf but names no replacement form, and the preposition-named oblique is defined for event PPs, so (Of <entity> <content>) is an extrapolation rather than a licensed form.

A bare mass / abstract noun carrying a restrictive modifier ('life in an urban slum'): the NP rule keeps a bare mass noun as a plain constant, but a constant has no symbol to hang the restrictive modifier on, so nothing licenses either the witness sk_life_1 or the alternative.
notes: Correctly declines to fuse the evaluative 'harrowing depiction' and the descriptive 'urban slum' (two atoms each, per the dented-pail line), and correctly treats 'depiction' as a plain kind rather than an agent-nominalization (it fails the 'one who/that Vs' test). Predicating depiction/harrowing of sk_movie_1 via the copula is right.
